title: ROM Sets May 2027 Opening for Hennick Entrance as Construction Continues
summary: The Royal Ontario Museum has announced a May, 2027 opening for the Hennick Entrance and Court, restoring access from Bloor Street after three years of construction. Designed by Siamak Hariri of Hariri Pontarini Architects, the new entrance and public gallery mark the next milestone in OpenROM, with work progressing on the entryway and a water feature at Bloor Street and Queen’s Park.
